tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The effective nuclear charge of an element with three valence electrons is 2.60. What is the minimum atomic number of the element?

solution.text:
As effective nuclear charge is 2.60 and valence shell contain 3 electrons so the minimum number of main shells for the given element are two i.e., (n = 2) and its configuration will be 1s2,2s2,2p1 .

Hence the given element has 5 electrons in all.

Also, for a neutral atom.

As number of electrons = atomic number = 5.

Thus, the atomic number of the element is 5.
